name: A Rule Has Been Deleted From The Windows Firewall Exception List
description: Detects when a single rules or all of the rules have been deleted from the Windows Defender Firewall
author: GAI_CTI
query: winlog.channel:Microsoft\-Windows\-Windows\ Firewall\ With\ Advanced\ Security\/Firewall AND ((event.code:(2006 OR 2052)) AND (NOT ((winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:(C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\* OR C\:\\Program\ Files\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*)) OR winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe OR (NOT _exists_:winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication) OR winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:"")) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:C\:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\ Defender\\Platform\\* AND winlog.event_data.ModifyingApplication:*\\MsMpEng.exe)))
